scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm run server"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.version:sync: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; const p=require('./client/package.json'); p.version=v; require('fs').writeFileSync('./client/package.json', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2)+'\n'); console.log('Synced client version to '+v);"
